copies the four floats at `rdx+0` to `rdx+0xC` both to `02097D30`-`02097D3C` and to `02098590`-`0209859C`, and stores `cl` to byte `02098DE9`

with p = qword `0209AC30`, when qword `p+0x3D0` is non-null it walks i = 0 to 22 and, for each qword `p+8*i` that is 0, stores `qword p+0x3D0` plus the zero-extended dword at `qword p+0x3D0 + 4*i` into it and calls `002A00F0` on that qword (re-reading p from `0209AC30`); both paths then tail-jump `00280AD0`

returns 0 when bit `0x800` of dword `rcx+0x10F68` is clear; else when qword `rcx+0x10F30` is non-null, p = `003F73D0(it)` is non-null and word `p+0x2F0` is below 4, it calls `003F6FD0(p)` and returns 0 if `edx` equals `r8d`, otherwise stores 2 to that word when it is 3, stores `r8d` to dword `p+0x2D4` and returns p; on the other path it returns 0 when `edx` equals `r8d`, else n = `00273A30(0, qword (qword 0209BE80)+0x10FC0, 0x340)` (0 returned when null), calls `00275550(n, 0x340)`, fills qword `rcx+0x10F50` with `0024A5A0(qword 01E0C1E0)` when it is 0, calls `00181250` and `00181000` on that qword q only when `00181540(q)` is 0, then calls `00271140(stack buffer, ...)`, `003F73F0(n, edx, r8d, buffer, q)`, stores `003F7380(qword rcx+0x10F30, n)` back to `rcx+0x10F30` and returns n
stores 0 to qwords `0215E6C0`, `0215E6B8` and `0215E6C8`, then stores qword `rcx+8` to `0215E6C0`
with p = qword `0215E6C0`, stores dword `p+0` to dword `0215E6B8` and the pointer `p+4` to qword `0215E6C8`

stores `r8` to qword `rcx+0x2C0` and returns when it is null; else calls `0032B1C0(rcx, r8)` and, with L = float(dword `01DFE0B4`)*60/60*15: when `0032B900(rcx)` is non-zero it increments dword `+0x320` capped at L, stores `0032C5E0(rcx+0x2E0, rcx+0x2F0, rcx+0x300, rcx+0x310)` to dword `+0x324` only if dword `01EED474` is non-zero, and clears `01EED474`; otherwise it decrements `+0x320` floored at 0 and, only if `01EED474` is 0, calls `003CC130(rcx+0x310, rcx+0x300, ...)`, stores its first output to float `+0x70` and 0 to byte `+0x40`, calls `0032B1C0(rcx, r8)` and stores the same `0032C5E0` call to `+0x324`, then sets `01EED474` to 1; both paths call `0032D000(rcx)`, `003CC080(rdx, rcx+0x330, rcx+0x340, 0.0)`, t = `00861F6E(+0x320/L, 0.16)`, `00202B70`, `00203080` and `00202DE0` on `rdx+0x20`/`+0x90`/`+0xA0`, and `001825C0(1, max(1+2t, -(1-0.8t)*f), ...)` with f the third float of the `00202B70` output; then add `00861F14` of the squared distance between floats `01EED440`-`01EED448` and `rcx+0x330`-`+0x338` to float `+0x368` and copy the four floats `rcx+0x330`-`+0x33C` to `01EED440`-`01EED44C`

stores 0 to dword `rcx+0x360` when `003D9FE0()` is 0, else stores `003D9FA0()` there when `003D9FD0()` is non-zero or the dword is 0; then returns 0 after clearing bit `0x80000` of dword `+0xC0` when `003D9FF0()` is 0, returns 0 when that bit is set or dword `+0x360` is 0, and otherwise calls `0032D250(rcx, dword 022C318C)` and r = `0032CA70(rcx)`, returning r when non-zero, else setting bit `0x80000` of `+0xC0` and returning 0; every path stores the returned value to dword `022C318C`

spills `rcx`, `rdx`, `r8`, `r9` to their home slots and calls `003CC130` twice, first with the addresses of the `rdx` and `rcx` slots, then with those of the `r9` and `r8` slots, each with three stack outputs; then tail-jumps `0032CC90` with `xmm0` the first call's third-argument output and `xmm1` the second call's

gets output triples (a1, b1, c1) from `003CC130(rcx+0x2E0, rcx+0x2F0, ...)` and (a2, b2, c2) from `003CC130(rcx+0x300, rcx+0x310, ...)`; adds 2π (`01CEBC78`) to a2 when `0032CC90(a1, a2)` is non-zero and a1 > a2, or -2π (`00915624`) when it is 0 and a2 > a1; with w = (`00861F08`(dword `+0x320`/L*π + π) + 1)*0.5, L = float(dword `01DFE0B4`)*60/60*15, stores A = a1 + w*(a2 - a1) to float `022C3198` and B = b1 + w*(b2 - b1) to `022C319C`, stores the w-lerps of floats `+0x2E0`-`+0x2E8` toward `+0x300`-`+0x308` to `+0x330`-`+0x338`, and calls `003CC2F0(rcx+0x330, A, B, c1 + w*(c2 - c1), rcx+0x340)`

stores 0 to qwords `+0x18`, `+0x20` and `+0x0`, dword `+0x28` and word `+8`, clears the low two bits of byte `+0x16` and stores 1 to byte `+0x15` of `rcx`; then fills the 29 dwords from `rcx+0x2C` (stride 4) with `0020E620(0)`

allocates n = `0036A190(0x1C0)` and returns null when it fails; else stores 0 to qword `n+0x110` and links n at the head of the list whose head qword is `+0x10` of h = qword `02EBEF88` (old head's qword `+8` = n when the old head is non-null, `n+0` = old head, `n+8` = 0, `h+0x10` = n), sets qword `h+8` to n when it is 0, and returns n

notes: 00259370: the body does `mov eax, ecx` and dereferences the zero-extended 32-bit value (`[rax+4]`), so the stored qword keeps only the low 32 bits of rcx. 0032C5E0: it passes the addresses of its own spilled argument slots (not the argument pointers themselves) to 003CC130; the row states this literally, so check whether the callee takes them by reference. 0032AEC0 and 0032D000: L is the 01DFE0B4-based bound computed with 60.0 (008F6D54) and 15.0 (00916314); 00861F6E/00861F08/00861F14 are named by address only. 0032D000 also stores a1 to a stack slot when the old 022C3198 minus A, or the old 022C319C minus B, lies outside plus or minus 0.3926991 (00915610/00D108F0); that slot is not read again, so the row leaves it out. 00291010 returns p on the reuse path because rax still holds the 003F73D0 result.
